visual.general_description: Three close-up clinical skin photographs labeled A (large, left), B (upper right) and C (lower right).
visual.detailed_description: Composite of three clinical photographs. Panel A fills the left two thirds and shows a cluster of translucent amber blisters with surrounding small papules and an eroded area on an erythematous background. Panel B (upper right) shows a brownish-red elongated patch with many small dark red-purple dots. Panel C (lower right) shows a large irregular dark violet-brown patch with scattered small dark red dots and a white band along the top edge. Only the panel letters are printed; there are no scales, rulers or identifying text.

panels.general_description: Clinical photograph of blistering skin lesions.
panels.detailed_description: Large close-up clinical photograph of skin filling the left two thirds of the figure. Against a pink to light-brown erythematous background there is a central cluster of three or four fused translucent amber fluid-filled vesicles or bullae, scattered smaller papules and vesicles around it, a crusted or eroded reddish area at the left and a small round erosion at the lower-left corner. The photograph has no scale, ruler or printed text apart from the panel letter at the lower left.

visual.general_description: Three pink-purple stained skin tissue micrographs labeled A, B (top row) and C (centered below).
visual.detailed_description: Composite of three histology micrographs. A (top left) is low power with a thin epidermis and a pale wavy layer lifted above it. B (top right) is intermediate power with a separated wavy layer at the left and a cellular dermis. C (bottom center) is high power showing epidermal cells at the left and a dermis crowded with small dark-nucleated cells. Only panel letters are printed; no scale bars, stain names or magnifications.

panels.general_description: Low-power micrograph of skin biopsy tissue.
panels.detailed_description: Low-power micrograph of a pink-purple stained tissue section. A thin epidermis runs across the upper half; above it a pale, wavy, thin layer is lifted away from the surface, leaving a clear space. The dermis below is pink with scattered dark nuclei and several clear round spaces. Panel letter A at lower left; no scale bar or text.
